name: @activepieces/piece-sign-now
description: eSignature platform for sending, signing, and managing documents.

auth.description: Connect your SignNow account using OAuth2. You will be redirected to SignNow to authorize access.

Authenticate using an API key from the SignNow dashboard.

1. Log in to the [SignNow API dashboard](https://app.signnow.com/webapp/developer-experience).
2. Go to **Apps and Keys** and select your application.
3. On the **API Keys** tab, copy your API key.

cancel_invite.name: cancel_invite
cancel_invite.description: Cancels an invite to sign a document.

document_id.description: The ID of the document whose invite you want to cancel.

reason.description: The reason for cancelling the invite.

aiMetadata.description: Cancels the pending field invite on a SignNow document, halting the signing request and notifying recipients. Use to recall or stop a signing flow already sent out. Requires the document ID and a cancellation reason; it mutates the document state, so it is not idempotent.

upload_document.name: upload_document
upload_document.description: Uploads a document to your SignNow account. Supports PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, images, and more.

file.description: The file to upload. Accepted formats: .pdf, .doc, .docx, .odt, .rtf, .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif, .bmp, .xml, .xls, .xlsx, .ppt, .pptx, .ps, .eps. Maximum size: 50 MB.

check_fields.description: Enable if your document contains simple text tags that should be converted to fillable fields.

aiMetadata.description: Uploads a file (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, image, and more, up to 50 MB) into SignNow as a new document and returns its document ID for later signing or invite steps. Optionally parse simple text tags in the file into fillable fields. Use this as the first step before sending an invite on an ad-hoc file. Each call creates a separate document, so it is not idempotent.

upload_document_and_extract_fields.name: upload_document_and_extract_fields
upload_document_and_extract_fields.description: Uploads a document and automatically converts text tags into SignNow fillable fields.

file.description: The file to upload. Text tags in the document (e.g. {{t:s;r:y;o:"Signer 1";}}) will be converted to fillable fields. Accepted formats: .pdf, .doc, .docx, .odt, .rtf, .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif, .bmp, .xml, .xls, .xlsx, .ppt, .pptx, .ps, .eps. Maximum size: 50 MB.

aiMetadata.description: Uploads a file (up to 50 MB) into SignNow as a new document and always parses its embedded text tags (e.g. {{t:s;r:y;...}}) into fillable fields, returning the document ID. Choose this over plain Upload Document when the file already contains SignNow text tags that should become signature/data fields. Each call creates a separate document, so it is not idempotent.

send_invite.name: send_invite
send_invite.description: Sends an invite to sign an existing document.

document_id.description: The ID of the document to send for signing.

from.description: Must be the email address associated with your SignNow account.

signers.description: One entry per signer role. Each signer needs an email, role name, and signing order.

role.description: Role name as defined in the document (e.g. "Signer 1").

order.description: Order in which this signer receives the invite. Multiple signers can share the same order to sign in parallel.

subject.description: Custom email subject for this signer.

message.description: Custom email body for this signer.

redirect_uri.description: URL the signer is redirected to after signing.

language.description: Language for this signer's signing session and emails.

expiration_days.description: Number of days before this signer's invite expires (3–180).

subject.description: Default email subject for all signers. Overridden by per-signer subject if set.

message.description: Default email body for all signers. Overridden by per-signer message if set.

cc.description: Email addresses to CC on the invite.

cc_subject.description: Subject line for CC recipient emails.

cc_message.description: Body message for CC recipient emails.

aiMetadata.description: Sends a role-based field invite for an existing SignNow document, emailing each named signer to sign. Use when you already have an uploaded document with defined roles and want recipients to sign. Requires the document ID, the sender email tied to the SignNow account, and one signer entry per role (email, role name, signing order); signers sharing an order sign in parallel. Each call dispatches new invite emails, so it is not idempotent.

create_document_from_template_and_send_i.name: create_document_from_template_and_send_invite
create_document_from_template_and_send_i.displayName: Create Document From Template & Send Free Form Invite
create_document_from_template_and_send_i.description: Creates a new document from a template and sends a free form invite to a signer.

template_id.description: The ID of the template to create the document from.

document_name.description: Name for the new document. Defaults to the template name if not provided.

to.description: Email address of the signer. A free form invite can be sent to the sender's own email address.

from.description: Must be the email address associated with your SignNow account.

subject.description: Subject line of the invite email sent to the signer.

message.description: Body message of the invite email sent to the signer.

cc.description: Email addresses to CC on the invite.

cc_subject.description: Subject line of the email sent to CC recipients.

cc_message.description: Body message of the email sent to CC recipients.

language.description: Language for the signing session and notification emails.

redirect_uri.description: URL the signer is redirected to after signing.

close_redirect_uri.description: URL that opens when the signer clicks the Close button.

redirect_target.description: Whether to open the redirect URL in a new tab or the same tab.

aiMetadata.description: Copies a SignNow template into a new document and sends a free-form (no predefined roles) signing invite to a single signer, returning the new document ID. Use for templates where the signer fills fields freely rather than by assigned role; for role-based templates use the role-based invite action instead. Requires the template ID, the signer email, and the sender email tied to the SignNow account. Each call creates a new document and dispatches an invite, so it is not idempotent.

create_document_from_template_and_send_r.name: create_document_from_template_and_send_role_based_invite
create_document_from_template_and_send_r.displayName: Create Document From Template & Send Role-Based Invite
create_document_from_template_and_send_r.description: Creates a new document from a template with fillable fields and sends an invite to one or more signers by role.

template_id.description: The ID of the template to create the document from.

document_name.description: Name for the new document. Defaults to the template name if not provided.

from.description: Must be the email address associated with your SignNow account.

signers.description: One entry per signer role defined in the template. Each signer must have an email and a role name (e.g. "Signer 1").

role.description: Role name as defined in the template (e.g. "Signer 1").

order.description: Order in which this signer receives the invite. Multiple signers can share the same order to sign in parallel.

subject.description: Custom email subject for this signer.

message.description: Custom email body for this signer.

redirect_uri.description: URL the signer is redirected to after signing.

subject.description: Default email subject sent to all signers. Overridden by per-signer subject if set.

message.description: Default email body sent to all signers. Overridden by per-signer message if set.

cc.description: Email addresses to CC on the invite.

cc_subject.description: Subject line for CC recipient emails.

cc_message.description: Body message for CC recipient emails.

expiration_days.description: Number of days before the invite expires (3–180). Defaults to 30.

language.description: Language for the signing session and notification emails.

aiMetadata.description: Copies a SignNow template into a new document and sends a role-based field invite to one or more signers matched to the template roles, returning the new document ID. Use for templates with predefined roles/fields where each signer is assigned by role name; for free-form signing use the free-form invite action instead. Requires the template ID, the sender email tied to the SignNow account, and one signer entry per role (email, role name, signing order); signers sharing an order sign in parallel. Each call creates a new document and dispatches invites, so it is not idempotent.

create_document_group_from_template_and_.name: create_document_group_from_template_and_send_invite
create_document_group_from_template_and_.displayName: Create Document Group From Template Group & Send Invite
create_document_group_from_template_and_.description: Creates a new document group from a template group and sends an invite to one or more signers.

template_id.description: The unique ID of the document group template.

group_name.description: Name for the new document group.

signers.description: One entry per signer. Each signer needs an email, role name, and the document they are signing within the group. Signing order determines the step sequence.

role_name.description: Role name as defined in the template (e.g. "Signer 1").

document_id.description: ID of the specific document within the group this signer is assigned to. Leave blank to assign to all documents.

action.description: What this recipient is allowed to do with the document.

order.description: Step order for this signer (1 = first). Signers with the same step number act in parallel.

subject.description: Custom email subject for this signer.

message.description: Custom email body for this signer.

language.description: Language for this signer's signing session and emails.

redirect_uri.description: URL the signer is redirected to after completing the document.

cc.description: Email addresses to CC on the invite.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new SignNow document group from a document-group template and sends a multi-step group invite to its signers, returning the group ID and per-document IDs. Use when several documents must be signed together as a package; for a single document use the document-template invite actions instead. Requires the document-group template ID, a group name, and one signer entry per recipient (email, role name, permitted action of sign/approve/view, and signing step); signers sharing a step act in parallel and each may target a specific document or all of them. Each call creates a new group and dispatches invites, so it is not idempotent.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom authenticated request to any SignNow API endpoint.

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

new_document.name: new_document
new_document.description: Triggers when a document has been uploaded to SignNow.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new document is created/uploaded in the connected SignNow account, signaling that a fresh document is now available to act on (e.g. send for signing).

document_updated.name: document_updated
document_updated.description: Triggers when a document has been updated.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when an existing SignNow document is modified, signaling a change to the document such as edits to its fields, fields filled, or status updates.

document_completed.name: document_completed
document_completed.description: Triggers when all signers have filled in and signed the document.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a SignNow document is fully completed, meaning every signer has filled in and signed it. Use to act on a finished, signed document (e.g. download, archive, or notify).

document_deleted.name: document_deleted
document_deleted.description: Triggers when a document has been deleted.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a document is deleted from the connected SignNow account, signaling that the document is no longer available.

document_group_completed.name: document_group_completed
document_group_completed.description: Triggers when all signers have filled in and signed the document group.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a SignNow document group is fully completed, meaning every signer has filled in and signed all documents in the group. Use to act on a finished multi-document signing package.

pt.The file to upload. Accepted formats: .p: O arquivo a ser enviado. Formatos aceitos: .pdf, .doc, .docx, .odt, .rtf, .png, .jpg, . peg, .gif, .bmp, .xml, .xls, .xlsx, .ppt, .pptx, .ps, .eps. Tamanho máximo: 50 MB.
pt.Enable if your document contains simple: Habilite se o seu documento contém tags de texto simples que devem ser convertidas para campos preenchíveis.
pt.The file to upload. Text tags in the doc: Arquivo para upload. Tags de texto no documento (por exemplo, {{t:s;r:y;o:"Signer 1";}}) serão convertidos em campos preenchíveis. Formatos aceitos: . df, .doc, .docx, .odt, .rtf, .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif, .bmp, .xml, .xls, .xlsx, .ppt, .pptx, .ps, .eps. tamanho máximo: 50 MB.
pt.The ID of the document to send for signi: O ID do documento a ser enviado para a assinatura.
pt.Must be the email address associated wit: Deve ser o endereço de e-mail associado à sua conta SignNow.
pt.One entry per signer role. Each signer n: Uma entrada por papel de assinante. Cada signatário precisa de um e-mail, um nome de função e um pedido de assinatura.
pt.Default email subject for all signers. O: Assunto de e-mail padrão para todos os signatários. Substituído por assunto por signatário, se definido.
pt.Default email body for all signers. Over: Corpo de e-mail padrão para todos os signatários. Substituído por mensagem por signatário, se definido.
Endereços de email para CC no convite.
Linha de assunto para e-mails de destinatário CC.
Mensagem de corpo para e-mails de destinatário CC.
pt.The ID of the template to create the doc: O ID do modelo para criar o documento.
pt.Name for the new document. Defaults to t: Nome para o novo documento. O padrão é o nome de modelo se não fornecido.
pt.Email address of the signer. A free form: Endereço de e-mail do assinante. Um convite de formulário gratuito pode ser enviado para o próprio endereço de e-mail do remetente.
pt.Subject line of the invite email sent to: Linha de assunto do email de convite enviado para o assinante.
pt.Body message of the invite email sent to: Mensagem do email de convite enviado ao assinante.
pt.Subject line of the email sent to CC rec: Linha de assunto do e-mail enviado aos destinatários da CC.
pt.Body message of the email sent to CC rec: Mensagem do e-mail enviado para destinatários da CC.
pt.Language for the signing session and not: Idioma para os e-mails de sessão e notificação.
pt.URL the signer is redirected to after si: URL para a qual a assinatura é redirecionada após a assinatura.
pt.URL that opens when the signer clicks th: URL que abre quando o assinante clica no botão de Fechar.
pt.Whether to open the redirect URL in a ne: Se deseja abrir o URL de redirecionamento em uma nova aba ou na mesma aba.
pt.One entry per signer role defined in the: Uma entrada por função de assinante definida no modelo. Cada signatário deve ter um email e um nome de função (por exemplo, "Assinante 1").
pt.Default email subject sent to all signer: Assunto de e-mail padrão enviado a todos os signatários. Substituído por assunto por signatário, se definido.
Corpo de e-mail padrão enviado para todos os signatários. Substituído por mensagem por signatário, se definido.
pt.Number of days before the invite expires: Número de dias antes do convite expirar (3-180). O padrão é 30.
pt.The unique ID of the document group temp: O ID exclusivo do modelo do grupo de documentos.
Nome para o novo grupo de documentos.
pt.One entry per signer. Each signer needs: Uma entrada por assinante. Cada signatário precisa de um e-mail, nome da função e o documento que eles estão assinando no grupo. A assinatura da ordem determina a sequência da etapa.
pt.Authorization headers are injected autom: Os cabeçalhos de autorização são inseridos automaticamente a partir da sua conexão.
Habilitar para arquivos como PDFs, imagens, etc.
